name: @pipeworx/mcp-giphy

tools.name: search_gifs
tools.description: Search Giphy for GIFs by keyword. Returns title, URL, rating, and multiple image sizes.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–25, default 10)

tools.name: trending_gifs
tools.description: Get currently trending GIFs on Giphy. Returns title, URL, rating, and multiple image sizes.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–25, default 10)

tools.name: random_gif
tools.description: Get a random GIF, optionally filtered by tag (e.g., "cats"). Returns title, URL, rating, and image URLs.

tag.description: Optional tag to filter by, e.g. "dogs" or "anime"

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-giphy forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the giphy pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
